body:
This branch is trying to tidy up https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaSeaIce.jl/pull/141 by making it compatible with `SeaIceModel` and usable in the coupled model. 
Some improvements are
- introducing a concentration evolution in the column thermodynamics
- remove the "stand-alone" thermodynamics mode and tight coupling in `SeaIceModel`
- using `model.external_fluxes` for the column thermodynamics 
- moving the column boundary conditions to the `HeatBoundaryConditions` module to reduce redundancy
- implementing flux boundary condition at the top and the bottom of the ice pack
- removing bespoke CPU kernels to reduce the number of lines of the PR
- adding a `SeaIceDiscretization` that account for ice growth and melt from the top or from the bottom
- falling back to a slab model when h < consolidation thickness.
title: Changes to the new thermodynamics branch
